methodology: Official public DLD latest-vintage snapshots. Projects require registered number + unique unchanged English name + stable developer identity + compatible official geography, independently reviewed. Community links are administrative area context only. No fuzzy joins, interpolation, future prices, event uplift, or historical point-in-time availability claimed. Raw rows stay private. Usage/type/registration and native subtypes remain explicitly separate; Ejari business property types (including Virtual Unit) are separate; sparse medians retained with n20 display gate. Entire duplicated single-property rental contracts are quarantined; invalid/future start or extreme end dates independently quarantined. Aggregate series overlap and are not additive. New specific first-party project proofs supplement unchanged exact native names/IDs; both raw-source and later identity-review availability are retained. Registered Land/Building asset histories remain published_reference and cannot anchor marketed Unit/Villa prices. Earlier packets are unchanged. All 590 native aggregates retained without numerical alteration. Forty Land/Building reference observations remain separate from the 550 marketed subject observations. Westwood Flat contracts start 7 December 2023 after the filed 27 November completion. S Tower contracts start September 2025 after filed June completion; one future-start contract is excluded. Neither contract observation nor ready registration certifies occupancy or realised income. First available date of modern primary review prevents historical backtest leakage.
